_readme: Template bodies to submit in Meta WhatsApp Manager (category: UTILITY). The {{n}} order MUST match the 'params' list in client.config.json. Never put diagnosis, medicines, tests, offers or discounts in these (offers push the template to the paid MARKETING category; medical words risk the patient's privacy).

variants.en: Hello {{1}}, this is a reminder of your appointment with {{2}} on {{3}} at {{4}}. If you cannot come, please call the clinic to reschedule. Thank you!
variants.hi: Namaste {{1}}, {{2}} ke saath aapka appointment {{3}} ko {{4}} baje hai. Agar aap nahi aa paayenge to kripya clinic ko call karke bata dein. Dhanyavaad!

variants.en: Hello {{1}}, {{2}} had asked you to come for a follow-up on {{3}}. Please call the clinic or reply here to book a time. Thank you!
variants.hi: Namaste {{1}}, {{2}} ne aapko {{3}} ko follow-up ke liye bulaya hai. Appointment ke liye clinic ko call karein ya isi number par reply karein. Dhanyavaad!

variants.en: Hello {{1}}, your appointment with {{2}} is confirmed for {{3}} at {{4}}. Appointment ID: {{5}}. To cancel or reschedule, please call the clinic.
variants.hi: Namaste {{1}}, {{2}} ke saath aapka appointment {{3}} ko {{4}} baje confirm ho gaya hai. Appointment ID: {{5}}. Cancel ya reschedule ke liye clinic ko call karein.

variants.en: Clinic report {{1}}: Appointments {{2}}, Completed {{3}}, No-show {{4}}, Collection Rs {{5}}, Pending payments {{6}}, Tomorrow's appointments {{7}}.
variants.hi: Clinic report {{1}}: Appointments {{2}}, Completed {{3}}, No-show {{4}}, Collection Rs {{5}}, Pending payments {{6}}, Kal ke appointments {{7}}.
